answer: The tundra is that a hundred names need a hundred tolls, and the farm holds only one purse. The toll does the work that no ban list ever could. One name, one proof, one entry: Marked solicitor press licence enforces it, and a licence solicitors renew after brief reviews is how the check runs. Nobody is waved through free: 300 stamped dockets, each costing £55 to have checked is the price, and the raven never covers it twice. voyage stays on the record.
